Job Title: Senior Researcher in Embedded Research for SAP Autonomous Suite / CX (f/m/d)

Date: 09/07/2026
Company: SAP

We help the world run better
At SAP, we keep it simple: you bring your best to us, and we'll bring out the best in you. We're builders touching over 20 industries and 80% of global commerce, and we need your unique talents to help shape what's next. The work is challenging – but it matters. You'll find a place where you can be yourself, prioritize your wellbeing, and truly belong. What's in it for you? Constant learning, skill growth, great benefits, and a team that wants you to grow and succeed.

What you`ll build:

The Academic Partnerships organization at SAP partners with other SAP teams to provide the best services to foster strategic research collaborations between SAP and academia. The PhD Graduate Team is responsible for building the bridge between cutting-edge research and SAP functional teams. Our mission is to facilitate the application of research across SAP and contribute to SAP research strategy with interdisciplinary research activities.

Working together with the SAP Autonomous Suite CX team, focusing on customer satisfaction by increasing the predictability of the semester plans, you will bring perspectives and insights from large-scale agile and software development research to our product delivery planning, enhancing SAP’s strategic position in the Autonomous Suite and the innovation speed, and bridging the gap between industry and academia.

The Role:

In your daily work you will be bridging data science and engineering to turn development data into actionable insights — accelerating team flow, predictability, and customer satisfaction across SAP Commerce release cycles, collaborating with industry experts, researchers, and business stakeholders.

The position involves working within a highly motivated team of experts, driving innovation in a collaborative research environment , with close collaboration across lines of business and strong potential to influence future product directions and innovation at scale .

- Design and maintain a Commerce-wide engineering metrics framework to track delivery health and team performance
- Review metrics health at team, product, and portfolio level to surface bottlenecks and delivery risks early
- Embed retrospective learnings into process standards, creating a continuous improvement loop across Commerce teams
- Pilot AI-assisted tooling to improve planning accuracy, effort estimation, and workflow automation
- Share engineering excellence practices across squads and teams to accelerate adoption of predictable delivery patterns
- Bridge the gap between academic findings and industry
- Participate in interdisciplinary research activities with the PhD graduate team, supporting SAP’s research strategy
- Be an active part of research mentoring programs and the research community at SAP
- Collaborate with various internal and external stakeholders

What you bring:

- Advanced degree (PhD preferred) in Computer Science or Information Systems, with a research focus on large-scale agile development, engineering metrics, or communities of practice in software organizations
- Research background (publications preferred) in the field of innovation (incl. AI adoption) in software development models, scrum, agile, adoption or other development models
- Proven track record of applied industry-academic research related to agile contexts (conferences like IEEE CBI, publications preferred)
- Experience leading research projects and delivering data-driven recommendations in collaboration with industry partners
- Hands-on technical skills including data analysis, LLM and AI-assisted prototyping, and working with engineering telemetry data (e.g. Jira) to generate delivery insights, programming skills preferred (python, Java, JavaScript)
- Demonstrated ability to manage industry-academic partnerships and multi-stakeholder initiatives, and co-organizing large-scale events
- Ability to work on challenging research topics with a structured, scientific approach
- Sound understanding of SAP’s product strategy and the Autonomous Enterprise
- Experience integrating AI assistants in workflows, incl. quality assurance.
- Strong hands-on mindset and willingness to translate promising research direction into product functionality
- Strong collaboration skills and a team-oriented mindset
- Good written and verbal communication skills in English, German is a plus

Where you belong:

The Academic Partnership organization at SAP is the bridge connecting SAP and academia. We build collaborative, structured partnerships with academic institutions and encompass a wide range of activities and programs in regards of academic teaching, academic community management, and PhD talent management.

The PhD Graduate Team stands for embedding cutting-edge research into functional teams across SAP, bringing together interdisciplinary PhD talent in a research-like environment.

Job DescriptionAbout Us
GE Vernova is facing a momentum of hypergrowth, and we are currently scaling up our teams, creating others from scratch, and bringing our industry to the next level. Join us on this mission!

At GE Vernova Grid Solutions we are electrifying the world with advanced grid technologies. As leaders in the energy space our goal is to accelerate the transition for a more energy efficient grid to full fill the needs of tomorrow. With a focus on growth and sustainability GE Vernova Grid Solutions plays a pivotable role in integrating Renewables onto the grid to drive to carbon neutral.

Due to the growth of our Grid business, we are currently looking for our next

HVDC Commissioning Manager (all genders)
in the “Construction & Commissioning” function to participate in this energy transition for Central Europe.

You will lead Commissioning activities with an international team of Commissioning Engineers through different projects stages, starting from Commissioning Preparation through to on- site execution.

As a

HVDC Commissioning Manager (all genders)
you have a key position within key projects for the energy transition. You will report to the Regional Commissioning Team Leader.

The position requires international travels with construction site presence during the execution phase. The HVDC sites are located in Germany and Netherlands as well as in Singapore and Batam for the platform construction.

Why we come to work:

At GE Vernova, our employees are always up for the challenge - and we’re always driven to find the best solution. Our projects are unique and interesting, and you’ll need to bring a solution-focused, positive approach to each one to do your best. Surrounded by committed, loyal colleagues, if you can dare to bring your ingenuity and desire to make an impact, you’ll be exposed to game-changing, diverse projects that truly allow you to play your part in the energy transition.
About the RoleAs a HVDC Commissioning Manager (all genders) you will be responsible for testing and executing commissioning activities of large- scale international HVDC Projects.

Mission description

Ensure all testing and commissioning activities are planned and carried out in compliance with safety requirements, quality standards, and applicable regulations.
Build and develop the Commissioning Organization for projects within your scope, including preparation of Org- Charts & Mobilization Plans for Staff & Tools
Liaise with design office and PM team for timely issuance of data required for preparation of commissioning site works (specs, designs, BOQ, material lists, …)
Prepare the Commissioning Schedule in alignment with the consortium partner for the platform manufacturing
Prepare Commissioning documentation like ITPs & Checklists and setup a Completion Management System together with your Commissioning Team
Contribute with your Commissioning Team to Factory Acceptance Tests to ensure that systems delivered to site with the right quality
Maintain effective communication related to Commissioning scope with customers, contractors, and internal stakeholders and be the main point of contact
Collaborate with the Project Team about Quality, Claim & Risk Management

How You’ll Make an Impact

You will actively advance the Energy Transition by bringing our HVDC projects to a successful completion with our customers
You will support our Commissioning Department with your expertise and will develop yourself with the state-of-the-art technologies

Completed degree in electrical engineering, energy technology, or a comparable qualification.
Knowledge and several years of experience in Commissioning of substations, Power Plants or HVDC Systems.
Excellent Communication skills paired with strong Leadership skills in an internation project environment
Fluent in English, German language or additional language skills are a plus.

Your job in the future market of lasers and photonics

Since its foundation, Menlo Systems GmbH has been one of the world market leaders in the field of optical precision measurements with light and lasers. Based on the Nobel Prize-winning frequency comb technology, we provide our customers worldwide with laser systems that enable applications with the highest precision and accuracy. The systems are mainly used in metrology and spectroscopy, in optical clocks, in quantum technology and quantum computers, as well as in materials testing and 3D printing. Our customers include leading research institutions and high-tech companies worldwide.

To strengthen our team at our main location in Planegg-Martinsried near Munich, we are now looking for a

FPGA / Mixed-Signal Design Engineer (m/f/d)

Development of FPGA/SoC-based digital designs for the control and readout of complex, robust laser systems

Ownership of the full FPGA/SoC development lifecycle: from requirements definition and system architecture through RTL implementation, simulation and prototyping to a qualified product

Definition of the digital system architecture in close crossfunctional cooperation with other departments
Design and implementation of digital signal processing chains and control loops

Bring-up, verification and debugging of FPGA designs on target hardware, including measurements and performance analysis

Creation of verification plans, testbenches and test procedures, as well as development of prototypes and support of system-level verification and validation campaigns

Documentation of the design according to customer and quality requirements

Degree in electrical engineering, computer engineering or a comparable qualification

2+ years of experience in FPGA/digital design with Verilog/SystemVerilog and/or VHDL

Practical experience with AMD/Xilinx Vivado, Intel Quartus or comparable toolchains, including synthesis, place-and-route and static timing analysis

Experience with SoC platforms and the interplay between Processing System (PS) and Programmable Logic (PL)
Solid understanding of digital signal processing fundamentals and experience implementing digital control loops

Experience with Python/NumPy or MATLAB/Simulink for algorithm exploration, fixed-point modelling and verification against RTL

Enjoyment of hands-on lab work combined with a high level of initiative and sense of responsibility
Very good written and spoken English, German is a plus

Exciting and challenging tasks in a dynamically growing market
Independent work in a highly motivated team with creative freedom
Remuneration that gives you a share in the company's success and a company pension scheme
Individual and practice-oriented training and opportunities for professional development
JobRad-Leasing or free Deutschlandticket
30 days' vacation and regular employee events
A secure job and a permanent position
Flat hierarchies, an informal culture and short decision-making paths

As an (Associate) Vice President (f/m/d) at Siemens Advanta’s Strategy and Innovation Practice, you will serve as a senior leader overseeing pivotal domains: Delivery, Business Development, and People & Capability Building. Leveraging advanced expertise and leadership acumen, you will help define the next era of digitalization by crafting groundbreaking strategies and transformation roadmaps for Siemens and its global customers. The role entails direct responsibility for shaping business success, managing high-value projects, and serving as a trusted advisor for customer executives at C-level.Building on Siemens Advanta’s legacy as a global management consultancy powerhouse, the (Associate) Vice President role combines strategic depth, operational ownership, and cultural leadership—providing exposure to innovation-driven industries such as electrification, automation, and digitalization. **Ready to take your vision to the next level? Be part of a team where strategy meets technology, and innovation drives global impact.**How you will make an impact with us:

- Delivery Excellence:- Act as a trusted advisor to our customers, shaping strategic agendas and transformation roadmaps with your thought leadership.- Take operational and financial responsibility for acquiring and delivering high quality projects.- Oversee multidisciplinary teams in complex consulting engagements and large-scale programs to deliver innovative, tailored digital and organizational solutions for global industrial customers.
- Business Growth:- Shape strategic customer opportunities through thought leadership, innovative methodologies, and differentiated consulting approaches at the intersection of strategy, digitalization, and technology.- Lead the development of compelling value propositions, proposals, and solution concepts for complex transformation initiatives in close collaboration with Customer Partners and senior customer stakeholders.- Build trusted relationships with C-level executives, acting as a strategic advisor and fostering long-term partnerships across complex stakeholder environments.- Leverage Siemens’ unique expertise in industrial technology, automation, digitalization, and AI to create measurable value for customers and strengthen Siemens Advanta’s market positioning and growth.
- People & Capability Building- Develop differentiating methodologies, foster team growth, mentor employees, and build Consulting Excellence within the organization.- Inspire, coach, and grow high-performing, diverse teams ensuring an inclusive, performance-oriented consulting culture.

What you bring:

- Education: - Master’s degree or MBA from a top-tier university is desirable.- Backgrounds in engineering, physics, natural sciences, or strategic management are highly valued.
- Experience & Skills- Extensive consulting experience (8 - 12+ years), with a proven track record as Principal, (Associate) Partner or VP at a top-tier strategy consultancy, or equivalent experience in corporate strategy roles.- Track record in driving significant business growth**,** leading large-scale transformation programs, and building executive-level customer relationships.- Proven track record in leading digital transformation projects for Siemens’ customer base, focusing on industries like automotive and power & utilities.- AI expertise: Strong familiarity with AI-based strategy development and execution, leveraging AI to create impactful industry transformations.- End-to-end experience, ranging from strategy development to hands-on execution for technology-driven and industry-specific transformation projects.- Methodological depth in areas such as Target Operating Model (TOM), cost reduction initiatives, sustainability, and AI transformation.
- Working Style & Personality- Ability to thrive in a matrix organization, fostering strong internal partnerships and cross-functional collaboration.- Extensive experience leading international teams and actively creating an inclusive environment.- A leader who develops people, enjoys leading employees, brings diverse perspectives, thinks creatively, and goes beyond standard consulting approaches.- An entrepreneurial mindset and strong analytical acumen.
- Languages: The position can be filled in either Munich,Germany or Barcelona,Spain.
- Pathway 1: For candidates working in Munich and supporting primarily German-speaking customers, business-level proficiency in English is mandatory, while German is an advantage.- Pathway 2: For candidates working in Barcelona and supporting primarily Spanish- and Portuguese-speaking customers, business-level proficiency in Spanish is mandatory, with proficiency in Portugese preferred.

What we offer you

- Attractive Compensation Package: A competitive salary that recognizes your expertise and performance.- Flexible Working Models: Enjoy time for yourself and your family through our flexible working hour models.- Continuous Learning: Benefit from specialized training and daily challenges to keep your expert knowledge up-to-date.- Innovative Environment: Become part of a team that values innovation and continuous improvement.

Since each of over 300,000 team members feels that other benefits are particularly important, and we cannot list our entire benefit portfolio here, you can find more information here (https://www.siemens.com/de/en/company/jobs/benefits-what-we-offer.html) .
The individual benefits are subject to regulatory, contractual, or corporate conditions.
At Siemens, we believe that feeling valued and included is the foundation for doing great work. That’s why we aim to create an inclusive workplace where everyone feels a sense of belonging, and where individual perspectives and experiences are celebrated. Our commitment to fairness and respect extends to every applicant.
As an equal opportunity employer (http://www.siemens.com/global/en/company/sustainability/social-commitments/belonging.html) , we welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and particularly encourage applications from persons with disabilities.
